title: Pipeline kit project config
description: Per-project config for the Loomspark pipeline kit, kept at .pipeline/config.yml in the project repo. It names secrets but never holds their values. See docs/design.md#project-config.

version.description: Config format version. Bumped only for breaking changes (docs/design.md#versioning).

verify.description: Commands every change must pass (milestone 1). Run in order in one job, after install; all run even if one fails.

nodeVersionFile.description: File passed to actions/setup-node to pick the project's Node version.

risk.description: Changed-path risk rules (milestone 1). A file's tier is the highest tier of any rule matching it, or defaultTier if none match; a change's tier is the highest of its files. Rules can only raise a file's tier above another rule's, never lower it.

enforce.description: true: the risk check fails for changes at or above approval.fromTier until approved. false: report only.

label.description: PR label an approver applies to approve a risky change. Approval counts only on the event that applies it: any later push or label change needs it re-applied.

hardRules.description: Rules checked on every diff (milestone 1). Only added or modified files and added lines are checked. Findings report rule, file and line only, never the matched text.

presets.description: Kit-provided rule sets to switch on.

forbidFile.description: Any added or modified file matching paths fails the rule.

forbidPatterns.description: JavaScript regular expressions; an added line in a matching file that matches any of them fails the rule.

previews.description: [Reserved, Phase 1] How to find a PR's preview URL. The kit only assumes a URL exists, never a host.

source.description: deployment: read the URL from the GitHub deployment status the host posts. command: run a command that prints the URL. none: no previews.

environment.description: Deployment environment name, for source: deployment.

journeys.description: [Reserved, Phase 1] Key journeys for the fixed end-to-end suite.

testData.description: [Reserved, Phase 1] Commands that reset and seed synthetic test data. Test data is always fictional.

models.description: [Reserved, Phase 3] Model choice per agent role, through an OpenAI-compatible gateway. Model ids and URLs are config; keys are secrets.

secrets.description: Names (never values) of the secrets each pipeline stage may use, keyed by stage. Values live in the project's GitHub Actions secrets or host secret store.

globs.description: Repo-root-anchored globs: ** any depth (dotfiles included), * within one path segment, ? one character, {a,b} alternatives.

ref.description: Requirement or ADR id this rule enforces, e.g. FR-PRV-5.
